text: きょうも　ツイて　ないんだ　きばらしに　つきあって　くれ！

structure.jp: きょうも　ツイて　ないんだ
structure.en: I'm out of luck again today

structure.jp: きばらしに　つきあって　くれ！
structure.en: keep me company for a change of mood!

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: てくれ after a verb is a rough, manly way to ask someone to do something for you. つきあって　くれ = 'come along with me'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says a state holds now; here it is shortened to て and made negative with ない. ツイて　ない = 'am not in luck'.

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end shows the speaker is explaining the situation. ツイて　ないんだ = 'the thing is, I'm out of luck'.
